name: Lesson 1 How to learn Chinese well（如何学好语文）
definition: 通过讨论学习困难和给出建议，学习表达问题与提供建议的核心句型。
key_points: 核心词汇：Chinese, English, problem(s), advice, important, ready, listen carefully, take notes, after class, more, talk with, hard, difficult, maths, art (含中文：语文、英语、问题、建议、重要的、准备好、认真听、记笔记、课后、多、与……交谈、困难的、困难的、数学、美术)
核心句型：I find Chinese hard. / I am not good at speaking. / I want to learn it well.
核心句型：What problems do you have in your study?
核心句型：It's important to be ready for class. / It's important to listen carefully in class. / It's important to take notes.
核心句型：You can read more Chinese books after class. / You can often talk with us after class.
语法点：find + 宾语 + 形容词（find it hard/difficult）；It's important to do sth.；be good at doing sth.
common_mistakes: find + 形容词 漏用 it 作形式宾语（误说 I find Chinese hard → I find Chinese is hard）
advice 不可数名词前误加 a（a good advice 应为 a piece of advice 或 some advice）
publisher: 广东教育出版社（粤教沪外教版）
